name: io.github.kcorehypervisor/kcore
title: kcore
description: Operate kcore clusters and VMs. Asks, plans, then applies over the controller API.

environmentVariables.name: KCORE_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the kcore context file. Defaults to ~/.kcore/config.

environmentVariables.name: KCORE_PROVISIONING
environmentVariables.description: host:port of kcore-provisioning when a call does not set connection.provisioning.

environmentVariables.name: KCORE_PROVISIONING_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for kcore-provisioning when that server requires authorization.

environmentVariables.name: KCORE_VAULT_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: host:port of the vault coordinator. Defaults to 127.0.0.1:9191.

environmentVariables.name: KCORE_VAULT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the vault coordinator when it requires authorization.

environmentVariables.name: KCORE_VAULT_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to present the kcore client certificate to the vault. Otherwise the dial is plaintext.
